set: A: the three keys, the sheet `machines` and the page at rest, whole, and native crops of each

issues.where: field crops at middle right, and the field across the arrow crop
issues.what: The lips have a bevel, but the field faces are opaque, even grey gradients. There is no visible glass edge or plane beneath the glass, so they read as generic shaded slots.
issues.fix: Give the glass a refractive bevel and a restrained grazing reflection, with a visibly separate backing plane beneath it.

issues.where: the arrow spanning the date-field rim, middle center
issues.what: The face stays matte off-white and most of the edge reads as a black outline rather than a lit sidewall. Its diffuse shadow does not visibly respond to the step from page to recess.
issues.fix: Render a shallow extruded sidewall with a glossy bevel and cast the offset shadow separately onto the page, rim, and lower field surface.

issues.where: the rotary dial and its tray in the upper crops
issues.what: The dial has layered metal and brushed highlights, but the broad shadow under its lower-right quadrant makes it look perched on top of the tray. There is no readable seat or mounting seam at the base.
issues.fix: Sink the outer dial housing into a machined opening with a narrow annular clearance and a tight contact shadow before the wider cast shadow.

issues.where: Continue button and surrounding page, upper right
issues.what: The cap is beveled, but the bright surround follows the cap as a trim line, and the outer shadow does the work of attaching the whole assembly to the page. A socket is not distinct from the cap.
issues.fix: Separate the cap from a recessed bezel with a thin dark clearance gap and a tight bezel-to-page contact line.

issues.where: volume meter segments in the upper-right crop
issues.what: The lit segments look like orange outline shapes with soft bloom rather than lenses set into the tray. The unlit segments have a raised outline but no clear socket wall.
issues.fix: Set each lens below a narrow seat, give the lit lens an interior gradient, and let a little orange light catch on the adjacent socket edge.
